title: SessLint Watch Event Format v1
description: One NDJSON line printed by `sesslint watch --json` (ux-reporting T-05) each time a watched file's verdict changes. Content-free: a privacy-minimized path, the previous and new verdicts, and the distinct finding codes of the new state.

path.description: Privacy-minimized path of the watched file: `~/...` under the home directory, otherwise `.._<hash>/<name>`; never a raw absolute path.

from.description: Previous verdict; `new` when the file had no earlier verdict.

to.description: New verdict. A file first seen healthy emits no event.

codes.description: Sorted distinct finding codes of the new state.
